reviews.text: It’s easy access and nice to walk around. It’s beautiful and feels safe even walking alone at 11pm and it still quite happening at the bar street. The rest was ok, some shop still open, also hawkers stalls for food and small bits like souvenir stall. Nice place overall.

Yes, it's touristy and commercialised but for the most part, this town still looks rather appealing. They've done well at blending in some of the streets with the surrounding scenery. The leafy side streets in particular were a pleasant sight. If you're in the area it's worth a visit just to have a wander around and go for a meal and a drink. I personally wouldn't recommend staying overnight here, however, as you're in one of the most naturally beautiful places on earth.... So why would you stay in a busy touristy town?!

It’s a nice tourist area, I visited on weekdays noon and only big restaurants are open. The street food seems to only open at night but I was able to get Guilin alcohol and sweets in a shop infront of Starbucks. There was also a shop that sells magnets, great place to but souvenir for keepsake!

Xiejie Pedestrian Street is a really good place to visit if you're looking to shop "western" items for cheap. There's an Adidas, McDonald's, etc! Would also like to mention that there is a Miniso, if you're looking to get cheap and affordable items; Blind boxes, Sanrio merchandise, Pixar, Disney, and more. There is a plethora of different shops, but for my recommendation, Momicafe is adorable and worth the visit! They house an amazing collection of really adorable charms with lovable designs, post cards, blind boxes, pins and more. If you're familiar with Shinto charms/omamori, I would recommend getting one! Other than that, it seems pretty lively as well even till late.

One of my favorite "Goldilock" night streets in the world, not too many people, not too much noise, the right ambiance as the cool night breeze and music flows. The entire street lights up as well as the surrounding mountains, perfect place to shop, have dinner, a beer, and stay out to people watch.

Crowded, Loud, Overpriced Loads of little shops all selling the same old tourist rubbish at double the price. Free to get in [it's just a street] but its not somewhere i'd go to twice. The best bit of Yangshou is the great scenery south of the city. Rent a bike and ride through the beautiful countyside - a much better use of your time

Awful street. If you walked one turist street in China, then you have walked them all. All the stores are basically the same and the employees are harassing you when you walk down the street by stuffing stuff in your face.
Touristy and commercialised for sure but still a place with visiting, even if to just have a look see. You can get shot of stuffs here but not necessarily at a cheaper price.
Beautiful sky. Numerous mountain peaks. Fresh air. Lively people and delicious food.

I came here 10 years ago and it was a pleasant historic street with some neat shops and an engaging atmosphere about it. It has become a ghost of its former self. In the evenings it is now overrun by hordes of tourists. The shops all sell snacks and knick knacks, advertising obnoxiously with flashing lights, loud speakers, thumping music, and people yelling through megaphones. It is a cacophony of petty consumerism that was almost physically painful to walk through. If you have to come, try coming in the morning when everything is closed and the streets are empty. Eat and drink elsewhere.

Main pedestrian shopping street in Yangshuo. Very commercialise and busy, full of food and what not. Early morning is the best time to capture the street view at the overhead bridge near the entrance, where traffic is light. Night time is quite overwhelming due to the endless crowd. It's nice to take a quick tour at night to soak in the local atmosphere.
A bit overwhelming and not very much option for street food compared to Guilin market. Very touristy and a lot of noise.

During the day - hot and crowded, but good opportunities for wandering, people-watching, and indulging in the usual tourist activities (shopping, having a fresh piece of fruit, get your feet nibbled on by fish). In the evening - utter, wall-to-wall chaos, which is fun to be in, but overwhelming.
Visited in 2017, very lively at night, standard tourist street (bars , restaurants, souvenir shops, etc.).
Not just West street but the whole area is vibrant and colorful. Not to be missed!

Pretty amazing experience, full of people and lots of little shops, you can walk here all day. There were lots of singers here and many of them were pretty awesome. Lots of bars as well. A little bit of everything for everyone. Prices were elevated compared to the hole in the wall establishments that real locals eat at. Quality is decent. Easy taxi ride from the Yangshuo railway station. To save money you can take a big shuttle bus from the Yangshuo railway station for 20RMB to the Fengming station then take a taxi to the pedestrian street.

Xijie Pedestrian Street is a center of attractions and tourism in Yang Shuo Town. Where all people from all over the world come and give a visit, Then they can do sightseeing, eating and shopping. There are many rows of shops sell many things like souvenirs, bags, shoes, foods and a shop called 88, all things on that shop sell with the same price of 8 Yuan each. Not only in the shop but some people also sell something on the roadside or even the middle of the road, they put a table and sell something there. For kids and all age, there's some shooting gallery using a rubber ball gun and archery. If you can shoot the minimum target you will get a doll as a reward. This area so clean, bright and nice to walk. Once you are there you will feel so happy and cheerful, because of the scenery the people and the unique things they sell. The price in the shops is not a fixed price you can bargain as low as your budget. If you get it you are lucky and if not find somewhere else or find another thing.
Lousy, touting, chaotic place. I don't like such a place pretending an old village however commercial indeed.
The street is filled with food, clubs, shops, and of course people. It's beautiful, but lots of hagglers for restaurants sometimes, just ignore them like what we did and you will be totally fine.

The best view from a mc donalds restaurant that I have ever been to, but unfortunately theres no wifi. All the restaurants along this area are nice. Great food and cheap prices. Would definately coma back and stay at the west street hotels
If you are tourist and staying in Yangshuo. Then I will suggest you to spend your all night at this street. It has a lot of shops, restaurants, clubs. A kind of busy street.
Great pedestrian street. Some good deals. Not as crazy as Yangshou. Good place to spend a few hours, or get a hotel near. Good food and some bars.

Love this place so much. Have been 4 times, though a lot of tourists now and some price gouging

Siamo arrivati a Yanghuo da Guilin con il battello e siamo stati una mezza giornata. Cittadina molto carina e vivace. La strada pedonale è sicuramente il luogo dove si trovano più ristoranti e negozi di souvenir ma uscendo un po' da questa via centrale si trovano cose molto simili (se non le stesse) a prezzi un pochino più bassi. Comunque è molto piacevole passeggiare per la città con le montagne che fanno da sfondo.

Yangshuo es una ciudad agradable para pasear pero sobre todo es punto de partida o de llegada para un atractivo crucero hasta/desde Guilin por el río Li, lugar de aproximación a visitas con vistas impresionantes (como Ruyi Peak), y sede del espectáculo "Impression Sanjie Liu" dirigido por Zhang Yimou.
就是個大夜市啊！ 有餐廳、酒吧、特產店、旅拍店、銀飾店，路幅不寬，遊人絡繹不絕，個人覺得餐廳口味普通，酒吧價位不便宜啊，路邊有部份餐廳提供免費的民俗舞蹈表演，就別太挑剔，邊吃飯喝酒看表演囉！

晚上超大夜市-陽朔西街 #烤玉米車 陽朔西街，是廣西壯族自治區桂林市陽朔縣的一條步行街。位於陽朔古鎮中心，寬約8米，長近800米，略呈東西走向，東到濱江路，西到蟠桃路，中間與縣前街、城中路交匯。歷經1400多年，是陽朔最古老最繁華的街道，也是陽朔重要的旅遊景點之一。明城牆、碑刻、古寺、古亭、名人故居、紀念館等這些古老的建築保存皆較完整。 提到陽朔西街哪裡好玩這個問題，實際上並沒有特別的景點，其西街大多以吃與夜店為名，而好玩好看的景點一般在灕江、印象劉三姐等其它地方，不過離西街挺近的，可以騎自行車逛下陽朔。
烤生蠔🦪一打¥68很便宜 連鎖店如大師傅啤酒魚之類做好的當地人都不吃 推薦富安魚港現秤現煮，waiter有廣東話嘅，喺西街出面 注意西街入面手信價格會貴50%左右

Phố đi bộ xijie hay còn biết đến là phố tây ở thị trấn dương sóc. Nơi đây tập trung nhiều cửa hàng bán sản phẩm địa phương phục vụ du lịch. Các cửa hàng xuống đèn lúc 12h đêm. Các quán bar mở không quá 2h. Phố đi bộ khá rộng lớn và sầm uất. Mình đi mãi mà không hết. Ở xijie có một trò chơi khá thú vị để giải xitrees đó là gào càng lớn thì cột nước sẽ càng cao. Giá của game này là 50 tệ cho 3 lần gào 🤑 Ngoài cổng khu phố có rất nhiều người mời đi taxi về khách sạn với giá 5 tệ/người. Lưu ý là với nhóm khách tối thiểu 4 người nhé.
Pusat belanja kaki lima yang ramai, dan banyak barang-barng murah. Wajib ke sini kalau lagi berada di kota Yangshuo.

20年前、ここは外国人旅行者や長期滞在者にとっての楽園でした。当時では考えられないくらいレベルの高い西洋料理のレストラン、カフェ、バーがローカル価格で利用可能。土産物も外国人観光客にとって本当に魅力的でした。 今はただの中国の地方都市の繁華街と変わりません。レストランの9割は中華料理です。全く「西」とは関係がないです。 そしてあらゆる店が観光地料金です。 西街から1キロ離れれば、桂林ビーフンはたったの5元ですが、ここでは18ドルです。 インスタ映え目当ての中国人以外には何の価値も無い場所になってしまいました。
Calle principal de Yangshuo animada y con mucha actividad repleta de comercios, sitios para comer, tiendas de souvenir...

Vor allem nachmittags und abends ein einmaliges visuelles und akustisches Getümmel. Waren jeglicher Art und Herkunft, von Bier und Speisen diverser Nationalitäten bis zu originellen Dingen, die niemand braucht: alles wird per Lautsprecher bis zur Übersteuerung angepriesen. Abends werden dieselben Menschen, denen man im Internet schwerverdauliche Kost wie Online-Lexika oder unabhängige Reiseforen nicht zumuten will, durch in gläsernen Fensterfronten Gymnastik treibende Deko-Damen animiert. Kurz: Auf engstem Raum konzentriert findet sich hier anschaulich, was von offizieller Seite zeitgenössisch als "Sozialistischer Kapitalismus" bezeichnet wird. Die Entwicklung vom populären, aber noch idyllischen Ort zwischen Karstkegeln zur illuminierten Feier- und Kaufmeile wurde allerdings auch hier wieder einmal durch hypende Rucksacktouristen initiiert, denen der - inzwischen überwiegend chinesische - Massentourismus folgte. Diese Marktgesetzlichkeit metastasiert mittlerweile bis in das nahe gelegene Naturreservat in Form von Hotelkomplexen, die auch dort die Dorfstrukturen ersetzen.
Calle más animada de Yangshuo. Hay numerosos bares donde comer, actuaciones, tiendas...
